property.name: mapreduce.framework.name
property.description: Run MapReduce on top of YARN rather than the legacy local runner.

property.name: mapreduce.map.memory.mb
property.description: Container memory requested for each map task.

property.name: mapreduce.reduce.memory.mb
property.description: Container memory requested for each reduce task (shuffle-heavy).

property.name: mapreduce.map.java.opts
property.description: Map JVM heap kept ~80% of the container to avoid swap.

property.name: mapreduce.reduce.java.opts
property.description: Reduce JVM heap kept ~80% of the container.

property.name: mapreduce.job.reduces
property.description: Default reducer count for the news token-frequency job.

property.name: mapreduce.task.io.sort.mb
property.description: 512 MB in-memory sort buffer per map before spilling to disk.
